scope: Rendered offline 4v4, 600 units kept alive with HP x100 (30 seconds) or x400 (120 seconds), normal 30 TPS and time scale; background user editor and game retained. Natural-health test is behavioral, not a constant-600 acceptance run.
limitations: FPS and game state vary with native avoidance and wall-clock command timing; staged results are not exclusive function costs.
Root GPU timing is not total GPU occupancy. Native navigation monitor includes game callbacks; monitors are cached maxima.
No claim of 600-unit network or Bot/worker performance, all maps, or an exclusive workstation.
A phase mean over 20 FPS does not guarantee every frame or one-second window over 20 FPS.

Input response is synthetic action/command submission to an observed updated frame, excluding OS mouse/keyboard and display latency. Route-ready means no pending request after command consumption; attack pursuit can directly steer instead. Opening first motion can be combat movement. Acceptance thresholds are declared benchmark criteria, not universal playability guarantees. Harness assertions validate evidence integrity, not FPS acceptance.
